text: Pellet, ko Alla woodani laamu kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin. Kafidiiɗo alanaa Mo e ɗum. Huunde suuɗaaki Mo e ɗin ɗiɗi. Himo wuurna ko O yiɗi wuurnugol, O wara ko O yiɗi warugol. Alanaa on, onon yimɓe ɓen, ko woori Alla, immorde e giɗo firlittooɗo e fiyakuuji mon, wanaa ballo duñanoowo on bone, wallitoo on e ayɓe mo'on.
